title: The Shadow Priest -- Beta
changeNote:
0.1.4 - Details history and potion attribution hotfix

- Fixed entire saved runs being hidden from Details history when an effect had no source ID. Existing affected reports now load automatically without changing their files or totals.
- Fire, Explosive, Block, and Blood Potion effects now receive their own source credit. Fairy in a Bottle healing is also attributed correctly. Recurring power effects retain their own names.
- Historical unattributed effects remain labeled as such; no damage or potion identities are invented.
- No card balance changes.

Restart Slay the Spire after Steam downloads the update, then open Details from the main menu to see recovered runs.
